BE IT RESOLVED THAT Council receive this report regarding the proposed donation of the property municipally known as 5 Main Street North, Chesterville, and acknowledge that Council previously authorized staff to proceed with the steps required to accept the donation, subject to finalization of the agreement and completion of the legal and administrative closing requirements;
AND THAT Council provide preliminary direction on the matters staff should analyze in a future options report with respect to potential uses of the property, including operating, capital, legal, risk, financial-sustainability and implementation considerations;
AND THAT any future use option be evaluated with the objective of generating sufficient revenue or other measurable financial benefit to offset the ongoing cost of owning and operating the building.
